No. 3682 of 2015.od In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay Bench At Aurangabad Criminal Application No. 3682 Of 2015 1. Anil S/o. Srimal Pitale, Age : 65 Years, Occ. Business 2. Abhay S/o. Anil Pitale Age : 45 Years, Occ. Business Both R/o. House No. 3735, Navipeth, Near Subhash Chowk, Ahmednagar. ..Applicants Versus 1. The State of Maharashtra Through The Secretary, Home Department, Mantralaya, Mumbai - 32 And Police Station Officer, Police Station, Rahuri, Dist. Aurangabad 2. The Food Safety Officer, Food & Drug (Authority) Commissioner, Ahmednagar ..Respondents ... Mr. R. R. Mantri, Advocate for Applicants. Ms. V. S. Chaudhary, App for Respondents. ... Coram :T.V. Nalawade And Smt.Vibha Kankanwadi,Jj. Date :27th November, 2018. Judgment
texts.facts: 2. The proceeding is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, for relief of quashing of First Information Report (FIR) bearing No. 345 of 2013 registered with Rahuri Police Station, District Ahmednagar, and also the proceeding No. 100-129 of 2015 pending before the Sessions Judge, Ahmednagar, filed in this crime for the offences punishable under Sections 328, 272 and 273 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1872 and two sections of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. 4. The FIR was given by the Food Safety Officer on the basis of adulteration noted by him and other officers on 06.12.2013. They had specific information that at one place one Pramod Ghorpade was manufacturing artificial milk and so they visited the place. Pramod Ghorpade was present at the place, Rahuri and when search of his house was taken, 83 plastic empty cans, each having 40 liters capacity, were found and three cans were containing some liquid. There was one Tata Pick up van containing three cans and in those cans also there was similar liquid. Other materials like - Sweet Whey powder (90 bags of 25 Kg), Murli refined soyabean oil (20 packets of 1 Kg), Gemini refined soyabean oil (23 bags of 1 Kg), Coco silver refined coconut oil 10 Kg, Krisp refined pam oil 62 cans containing of 15 Kg each, five empty boxes of oil, one electric motor and agitator for mixing liquid material, one Jaypan Mixer, three electrical scales, 10 drums having capacity of 180 liters, some chemical powder and other articles which are used for mixing chemicals etc. 5. Samples of the liquid which was already prepared were taken and samples of other articles were also taken and when action was being taken, Ghorpade ran away from the place. All these articles were taken over as it becomes clear that Ghorpade was creating artificial milk and it was being used for adulteration of milk which is brought to the market for sale. Report was given against him. After his arrest, it transpired that he was purchasing the material like powder which was used for manufacturing of artificial milk from Abhay Chemical Industries, the concern of the present applicant. 6. Applicant No.1 is the father of applicant No.2. The learned counsel for applicant submitted that except the record of the bills in respect of sale of 'Sorbital' by Abhay Chemical Industries, there is no record against the applicants and so the applicants are entitled to get the relief. The bill/tax invoice shows that 300 Kg. Sorbital was sold for consideration of Rs.18,900/- by Abhay Chemical Industries. The name to industry is given on the basis of name of applicant No.2. A copy of license obtained in respect of this industry is produced on record and it shows that Abhay Pitale is shown as the proprietor of Abhay Chemical Industries and it has the license to store and sell two substances like Methanol (1000 liters) and Actroniletriile (500 liters). This copy was supplied by Anil Pitale, as signature of Anil Pitale is appearing on the photocopy produced on record. The certificate of registration of Abhay Chemical Industries as Wholesale Dealer and Importer is in the name of Anil Pitale. They are Hindus and on the basis of this record, for present purpose, inference is easy that they together are doing the business. There is Chemical Analysis report showing that Sorbital was Anil S/O Srimal Pitale And Anr vs The State Of Maharashtra & Anr on 27 November, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/189057233/ 2 detected in the samples of liquid which were collected by the Safety officer from place of Ghorpade. 7. The learned A.P.P took this Court to various provisions of Food Safety Act 2006.
